files.title: Diploma in Alternative Dispute Resolution Ac Year 2025-26

subjects.title: Introduction of ADR: National and International Perspective

units.title: Historical Development and Conceptual Framework of ADR
units.topics: Meaning and Definition of ADR, Traditional dispute resolution & Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS) in ancient India: Panchayats, Nyaya Panchayats, village councils. Evolution of ADR mechanisms in India and globally, Arbitration Act 1940 limitations, Liberalization and UNCITRAL Model Law.

units.title: Traditional ADR Systems in India
units.topics: Indigenous dispute resolution mechanisms, community mediation, religious councils, and evolution toward statutory framework.

units.title: Alternative Dispute Resolution in the Context of Access to Justice
units.topics: Constitutional mandate under Article 21, 39A; Section 89 of Code of Civil Procedure 1908, role of ADR in reducing judicial pendency and promoting accessible justice.

units.title: International Perspectives on ADR
units.topics: International commercial arbitration, institutional arbitration centers (ICC, SIAC, LCIA), UNCITRAL Arbitration and Conciliation Rules, WTO Dispute Settlement Body.

units.title: General Provisions
units.topics: Objectives and scope of Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996, salient features, key definitions, distinction between arbitration, conciliation, mediation & negotiation.

units.title: Arbitration & Arbitration Council of India
units.topics: Arbitration agreement, composition of arbitral tribunal, jurisdiction, conduct of arbitral proceedings, making of arbitral award, termination, recourse against arbitral award (Section 34), finality and enforcement.

units.title: Conciliation
units.topics: Scope and applicability of Part III of 1996 Act, appointment of conciliators, conciliation procedure, settlement agreement and its legal effect.

units.title: Enforcement of Foreign Awards
units.topics: New York Convention Awards, Geneva Convention Awards, recognition and enforcement procedures, grounds for refusal in India: public policy and other defences, judicial precedents.

units.title: Recent Developments and Amendments to the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996
units.topics: Major amendments (2015, 2019, 2021) to Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996, institutional arbitration promotion in India.

subjects.title: Negotiation and Mediation Law in India

units.title: Theories and Process of Negotiation
units.topics: Concepts, types: distributive and integrative negotiation, BATNA, WATNA, ZOPA, negotiation styles, strategies, and ethics in negotiation.

units.title: The Mediation Act, 2023 - Historical Context & Key Provisions
units.topics: Background and objectives of Mediation Act 2023, scope and applicability: civil, commercial, family and community disputes, definitions and institutional framework.

units.title: Pre-Litigation and Court Referred Mediation
units.topics: Pre-litigation mediation under Mediation Act 2023, mandatory mediation in specified disputes, exempted disputes (Schedule I), mediation process: notice, consent, timelines, court-annexed mediation.

units.title: Conduct and Regulations of Mediation
units.topics: Role, duties, and code of conduct of mediator, confidentiality, Mediated Settlement Agreement (MSA), registration and enforcement of MSA, challenge grounds.

units.title: Cross-Border Mediation and the Singapore Convention
units.topics: United Nations Convention on International Settlement Agreements Resulting from Mediation (Singapore Convention), international commercial mediation enforcement.

subjects.title: ADR under Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 & Other Laws

units.title: The Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987
units.topics: NALSA, SLSA, DLSA, TLSC: composition, functions, powers, eligibility criteria for free legal aid under the Act.

units.title: Lok Adalats and Permanent Lok Adalats
units.topics: Lok Adalats: concept, jurisdiction, procedure, nature and binding effect of awards (Section 21). Permanent Lok Adalats (PLAs): public utility services jurisdiction, procedure.

units.title: ADR Provisions in Other Legislations
units.topics: Section 89 CPC, Commercial Courts Act 2015 pre-institution mediation, Family Courts Act 1984, Industrial Disputes Act 1947, Consumer Protection Act 2019 mediation cells, RERA conciliation forums.

units.title: Landmark Judicial Decisions on ADR
units.topics: Afcons Infrastructure, K. Srinivas Rao, Jagdish Chander, Vidya Drolia, BALCO, and other Supreme Court rulings promoting ADR.

units.title: Simulation Exercises and Mock Sessions
units.topics: Mock Arbitration Sessions, Mock Mediation Sessions, Mock Lok Adalat Proceedings.

units.title: Drafting Exercises
units.topics: Drafting Domestic Arbitration Agreement, Application for appointment of Arbitrator, Application to set aside Arbitral Award, International Arbitration Clause, Mediated Settlement Agreement.

units.title: Field Visits and Court Observations
units.topics: Visits to Lok Adalats, DLSA offices, Mediation Centers, Arbitration Institutions; preparation of detailed observation reports.

units.title: Viva-Voce Examination
units.topics: Viva-voce examination on journal submission and practical training.

files.title: Diploma in Human Rights and InternationalLaw Ac Year 2025-26
files.programme: Diploma in Human Rights and International Law

subjects.title: Human Rights: Philosophical Foundations and Global Frameworks

units.title: Evolution and Philosophy of Human Rights
units.topics: 1.1 Concept and Characteristics of Human Rights: Meaning and definition, essential features, Evolution from moral to legal rights, Sources, Human Rights vs. Fundamental Rights, Universality vs. cultural relativism. 1.2 Legal and Philosophical Foundations: Natural law and natural rights, Social contract, Legal positivism, Concept of justice and liberty, Human dignity. 1.3 Ancient Indian Perspective on Rights and Duties: Dharma, Vedas, Smritis, Arthashastra, Ashokan edicts, Buddhist ethics, Jain and Sikh contributions. 1.4 Human Rights Traditions in Religions: Hindu, Islamic, Christian, Buddhist, Comparative religious perspectives. 1.5 Role of National Movements and Historical Struggles: Indian freedom struggle, Anti-colonial movements, Gandhi’s Swaraj and Sarvodaya, Press and civil society.

units.title: Global Development of Human Rights Norms
units.topics: 2.1 Early Milestones in Human Rights History: Magna Carta, English Bill of Rights, American Declaration of Independence, French Declaration of Rights of Man, Atlantic Charter. 2.2 UN Charter and the Universal Declaration: Formation of UN, Preamble, Eleanor Roosevelt and UDHR drafting, Articles of UDHR, Legal and moral impact. 2.3 ICCPR: Civil and Political Rights: Right to life, Freedom of expression, movement, assembly, Fair trial, Emergencies and derogation, Minority rights, Digital privacy. 2.4 ICESCR: Economic, Social, and Cultural Rights: Right to work, education, health, social security, food, housing, water, Labour rights. 2.5 Third Generation / Solidarity Rights: Right to development, clean environment, peace, disarmament, future generations, Indigenous peoples.

units.title: Regional Human Rights Protection Systems
units.topics: 3.1 European Human Rights System: ECHR, European Court of Human Rights, Jurisdiction, Case law, Compliance mechanisms. 3.2 Inter-American Human Rights System: American Declaration and Convention, Inter-American Commission, Inter-American Court, Key cases. 3.3 African Human Rights System: African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights, Commission and Court, AU role. 3.4 Arab and Asian Regional Mechanisms: Arab Charter, AICHR, Islamic Charter, Soft law mechanisms. 3.5 Role of UNESCO and ILO: UNESCO right to education, ILO labour standards, Global conventions, Labour inspections.

units.title: Contemporary Global Challenges
units.topics: 4.1 Human Rights in the Digital Age: Privacy, data protection, surveillance, AI ethics, algorithmic bias. 4.2 Human Rights during Conflict and Terrorism: Derogation, War crimes, Geneva Conventions, Anti-terror laws, IHL, UNHRC, Red Cross. 4.3 Refugees and Migrant Rights: Refugee Convention 1951, Asylum seekers, Statelessness, UNHCR. 4.4 Environmental Justice and Climate Rights: Stockholm, Rio, Paris, Clean air and water, Climate migration, Ecocide. 4.5 Business and Human Rights: UN Guiding Principles (Ruggie Framework), CSR, Supply chain accountability, Labour rights in MNCs, ISDS.

units.title: Vulnerable Groups in International Human Rights
units.topics: 5.1 Women and Children’s Rights: CEDAW, CRC, Female infanticide, trafficking, reproductive rights, Gender-based violence. 5.2 Elderly and Disabled Persons’ Rights: UNCRPD, Social security, Disability justice, Community-based rehabilitation. 5.3 Indigenous and Tribal Rights: UNDRIP, Land and resource rights, Cultural preservation, Autonomy. 5.4 LGBTQIA+ Rights: Decriminalisation, Right to marriage, adoption, healthcare, Transgender rights, Hate speech. 5.5 Refugees, Stateless Persons, IDPs: Statelessness, Asylum process, Resettlement, IDP protection under UN Guiding Principles.

subjects.title: Human Rights and Legal Protection in India

units.title: Constitutional Foundations and Indian Human Rights Framework
units.topics: 1.1 Impact of UDHR on Indian Constitution: Part III and Part IV, Dr. Ambedkar’s role, Constitutional Assembly Debates, Article 51. 1.2 Interrelationship of Fundamental Rights and Directive Principles: Harmonization of Parts III and IV, Evolution through PILs, Non-enforceability and moral force, Right to education (Article 21A). 1.3 Indian Reservations to ICCPR/ICESCR: Approach to treaties, 1979 declaration, Dualism, Treaty ratification. 1.4 Constitutional Morality and Human Welfare: Preamble, Justice, liberty, equality, Affirmative action, National integration. 1.5 Rule of Law and Indian Constitutionalism: Dicey’s concept, Basic feature, Legal aid, Access to justice, Safeguards.

units.title: Statutory and Institutional Frameworks
units.topics: 2.1 Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993: Background, Definitions, Functions and powers of NHRC, Inquiry procedures, Human Rights Courts. 2.2 State Human Rights Commissions & Special Courts: Structure, composition, jurisdiction, functioning of SHRCs, Special Courts. 2.3 Commissions for Vulnerable Sections: NCW, NCSC, NCST, NCM, NCPCR, Working methods, Reports. 2.4 Role of NGOs and Civil Society: Classification, PUCL, HRLN, CHRI, Advocacy, documentation, litigation, FCRA. 2.5 Legal Services Authorities and Access to Justice: Legal Services Authorities Act 1987, NALSA, SLSAs, Lok Adalats, Paralegal volunteers.

units.title: Judicial Interpretation and Human Rights Jurisprudence
units.topics: 3.1 Expansion of Rights through Judicial Interpretation: Right to life (Art. 21), Environmental rights, Health, shelter, livelihood, International law in Indian judgments. 3.2 Public Interest Litigation and Judicial Activism: Origin and scope of PIL, Relaxation of locus standi, Bonded labour, child rights, Landmark PIL judgments. 3.3 Rights of Marginalized Populations: Prisoners, custodial deaths, Bonded labour, Child labour (PENCIL, JJ Act), Compensation jurisprudence, Habeas corpus. 3.4 Gender Justice and the Judiciary: Vishaka guidelines, Domestic Violence Act, Triple Talaq, Marital rape debate, Reproductive autonomy. 3.5 Landmark Judgments Shaping Indian HR Law: Maneka Gandhi, Olga Tellis, PUCL, K.S. Puttaswamy, Navtej Singh Johar, S.R. Bommai.

units.title: Socio-Legal Challenges and Human Rights
units.topics: 4.1 Caste, Discrimination, and Reservation: Caste-based exclusion, Articles 15, 17, 46, Reservation policy, Atrocities Act, Dalit rights movement. 4.2 Uniform Civil Code and Personal Laws: Article 44, Secularism vs pluralism, Gender discrimination, Triple talaq, Special Marriage Act. 4.3 Right to Health and Healthcare Policy: Right to health under Art. 21, National Health Policy, Reproductive rights, Mental health rights (MHA 2017), COVID-19. 4.4 Poverty, Inequality, and Development: Poverty as HR violation, Hunger, malnutrition, right to food, Welfare schemes. 4.5 Human Rights in the Digital Age: Right to internet, Data privacy, surveillance, Facial recognition, AI, Cyber bullying, IT Act.

units.title: Duties, Ethics, and Human Rights Practice
units.topics: 5.1 Fundamental Duties and Constitutional Morality: Article 51A, Rights and duties relationship, Gandhi’s idea of self-discipline. 5.2 Civic Ethics and Community Participation: Role of individuals, Community policing, Youth participation, Ethics in HR work. 5.3 Media and Human Rights: Freedom of press, Exposing HR violations, Sensationalism vs ethical journalism, Fake news. 5.4 Legal Literacy and Human Rights Education: Legal literacy campaigns, Street theatre, Vernacular languages, Engaging youth. 5.5 Decentralised Governance and Local HR Initiatives: Panchayati Raj, Gram-Sabhas, Participatory budgeting, Social audits, RTI.

units.title: Nature, Characteristics & Sources of International Law
units.topics: 1.1 Definition and Scope, 1.2 Subjects of International Law (States, individuals, international organizations), 1.3 Public vs. Private International Law, 1.4 Voluntary consent and state sovereignty, 1.5 Binding force of international obligations, 1.6 Enforcement challenges, 1.7 Treaties and conventions, 1.8 Customary International Law, 1.9 General principles of law recognized by civilized nations, 1.10 Judicial decisions and scholarly writings, 1.11 Equity, ex aequo et bono

units.title: International Law, Human Rights and the United Nations
units.topics: 2.1. How international law evolved to include individual rights, 2.2. Human rights as jus cogens norms (peremptory norms), 2.3. The role of international law in codifying human rights post-1945, 2.4. UN Charter and the promotion of peace and human rights, 2.5. Role of UN General Assembly and Security Council in International Law, 2.6. ICJ and its contribution to human rights jurisprudence

units.title: Implementation of International Law in Domestic Systems
units.topics: 3.1 Monism vs. Dualism, 3.2 India’s approach: Constitutional provisions, judicial interpretations (e.g., Vishaka case, PUCL case), 3.3 Challenges of enforcement in municipal law

units.title: Recognition, Statehood and Jurisdiction
units.topics: 4.1 Criteria for statehood (Montevideo Convention), 4.2 Recognition of states and governments, 4.3 Jurisdiction: Territorial, personal, protective, universal, 4.4 Sovereign immunity and diplomatic immunities

units.title: Law of Treaties & International Responsibility of States
units.topics: 5.1 Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties (1969), 5.2 Formation, interpretation, termination of treaties, 5.3 Reservations and invalidity of treaties, 5.4 Wrongful acts, attribution, and consequences, 5.5 Reparation, restitution, satisfaction, 5.6 Responsibility of international organizations

subjects.title: International Institutions and Contemporary Issues in International Law

units.title: United Nations and Maintenance of International Peace
units.topics: 1.1 UN Charter and collective security, 1.2 Role of General Assembly, Security Council, and ICJ, 1.3 UN Peacekeeping and peace building, 1.4 Veto power and criticism of the Security Council

units.title: International Humanitarian Law (IHL) & International Criminal Law
units.topics: 2.1 Geneva Conventions and Additional Protocols, 2.2 Principles of distinction, proportionality, military necessity, 2.3 Protection of civilians and prisoners of war, 2.4 War crimes and enforcement, 2.5 Concept of individual criminal responsibility, 2.6 Nuremberg and Tokyo Tribunals, 2.7 International Criminal Court (ICC): Rome Statute, jurisdiction, admissibility, 2.8 Crimes: Genocide, crimes against humanity, war crimes, aggression

units.title: Global Economic and Environmental Governance
units.topics: 3.1 Role of WTO, IMF, World Bank in international economic law, 3.2 Principles of international environmental law, 3.3 Paris Agreement, UNFCCC, Biodiversity, and Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), 3.4 Common but differentiated responsibility

units.title: Dispute Resolution & Regional Organisations and Their Role in International Law
units.topics: 4.1 Peaceful methods: Negotiation, mediation, arbitration, judicial settlement, 4.2 International Court of Justice (ICJ): Composition, jurisdiction, key cases, 4.3 Permanent Court of Arbitration, ITLOS, 4.4 European Union and international legal personality, 4.5 African Union and conflict resolution, 4.6 ASEAN, SAARC – cooperative frameworks and limitations, 4.7 OAS and regional dispute mechanisms

units.title: Contemporary Developments and Challenges
units.topics: 5.1 Use of force and humanitarian intervention (e.g., R2P), 5.2 Cyber warfare and digital sovereignty, 5.3 International law and AI / technology governance, 5.4 Global health law and pandemic response (WHO, IHR), 5.5 Migration, refugees, and statelessness, 5.6 Growing role of individuals and NGOs in shaping international law

units.title: Journal and Viva voce
units.topics: 1. Journal: Report Writing on a Guest Lecture / Workshop; Case Observation Writing (Court visit for case observation relating to violation of Human Rights); Write any 5 leading case laws on Human Rights; Visit to National or State Human Rights Commission, NCW, NCPCR, NGOs dealing in HR protection; Visit to institutions like Jail, Police station, Prison, Juvenile Justice Board, Borstal School, Remand Home. 2. Viva voce

files.title: Diploma in Intellectual Property Law Ac Year 2025-26

units.title: Nature, Concept and History of Patents
units.topics: Nature and Concept and Types of Intellectual Property, Historical background of the Patent System in India and in the global context, Concept of Patentability and non-patentability.

units.title: Patent Filing, Opposition and Revocation
units.topics: Patent filing Procedure in India and concept of patent of addition, divisional patent application, Opposition, Surrender, Revocation of Patents.

units.title: Rights, Licensing and Infringement
units.topics: Technology Transfer and Patent Licensing, Patentee Rights - Product and Process patents, Infringement and remedies under Indian Patent Act 1970.

units.title: Authorities and International Conventions
units.topics: Authorities under Patent Act, Compulsory Licensing, International Instruments: Paris Convention, Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT), Budapest Treaty, TRIPS Agreement.

units.title: Concept and Principles of Copyright
units.topics: Concept and Principles of Copyright and Neighbouring Rights, Historical background and Development of Copyright Law at National and International context, Copyrightable subject matter.

units.title: Neighbouring Rights and Registration
units.topics: Neighbouring Rights- Broadcasting Organization Rights and Performers right, Filing Procedure of Copyright, Term of protection, Ownership of Copyright.

units.title: Rights, Assignment and Licensing
units.topics: Rights conferred under Copyright Act: Economic Rights, Moral Rights, Assignment and Licensing of Copyright, Compulsory and Statutory Licensing, Copyright Societies.

units.title: Infringement, Authorities and International Conventions
units.topics: Infringement of Copyright and remedies, Exceptions to Infringement (Fair use doctrine), Authorities under Copyright Act 1957, International Conventions: Berne Convention, Universal Copyright Convention, WCT, WPPT.

units.title: Concept and Types of Trademarks
units.topics: Concept of Trademarks, Historical background and Development in India and globally, Different Kinds of Marks: Service, Certification, Collective, Associated marks, Well-known trademark and passing off, International classifications (Nice).

units.title: Registration and Ownership Rights
units.topics: Procedure of registration of Trademark, Grounds for Refusal (Absolute & Relative), Term of Protection, Rights of Trademark owner.

units.title: Assignment, Licensing and Infringement
units.topics: Assignment and Transmission, Licensing of Trademark, Infringement and remedies (Civil, Criminal, Administrative), Difference between Passing off and Infringement, Domain names and cyber squatting.

units.title: Authorities and International Conventions
units.topics: Authorities under Trade Marks Act 1999, International Treaties: Paris Convention, Madrid Agreement and Protocol, Trademark Law Treaty.

units.title: Part I: Industrial Designs
units.topics: Meaning of Design, essential requirements, exclusions, procedure for registration, copyright in registered designs, assignment, licensing, infringement, remedies, Design Act 2000, Locarno Agreement.

units.title: Part II: Geographical Indications
units.topics: Meaning and concept of Geographical Indications, registration procedure, rights conferred, infringement and remedies, Geographical Indications of Goods Act 1999, Lisbon Agreement.

units.title: Part III: Semiconductor Integrated Circuits Layout-Design
units.topics: Conditions for registration, procedure, effect, duration, infringement, authorities under The Semiconductor Integrated Circuits Layout-Design Act 2000.

units.title: Part IV: Plant Variety Protection Act
units.topics: Meaning, benefit sharing and farmers rights, registration procedure, effect, term, authorities under Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers Rights Act 2001, offences, penalties, infringement.

units.title: Patent Search Analysis
units.topics: Conducting patent search on databases (InPASS, Google Patents, Espacenet, WIPO Patentscope), patent analysis and landscaping report.

units.title: Trademark Search and Application Drafting
units.topics: Trademark clearance search using IP India public search, drafting Trademark Application (TM-A).

units.title: Copyright Registration Drafting
units.topics: Drafting copyright registration application for literary, artistic, or software works.

units.title: Viva-Voce Examination
units.topics: Viva-voce examination on journal submissions, case studies, and practical IP filing documents.
